title: Memoize secret scans and shorten run_check polling; record timings
summary: Land two behavior-preserving speedups: a per-process memo in Gitleaks::scan_text (crates/athena-gate/src/secrets.rs) and a shorter poll schedule in run_check (crates/athena-core/src/checks.rs, currently a fixed 200 ms sleep). Measure full cargo test --locked before and after, and record both in docs/decisions.md with nextest as a rejected alternative. The audience is the maintainers, who judge whether the change is safe and the timings are honest.

defaults_applied.how: New tests for the memo and the poll schedule; full cargo test and clippy pass.
Timings in docs/decisions.md are measured, or labelled as prior estimates.
Criteria run tests that check unchanged behavior, not just that code exists.
Only the four named files change.
Behavior criteria name cargo commands the verifier can run.
nextest is recorded as a rejected alternative.
The criteria check that findings and timeouts are unchanged, not that code was written.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Poll schedule: start with short sleeps (e.g. 5 ms) that back off to the existing 200 ms cap; completion and timeout semantics are unchanged.
Memo is bounded in entry count and text size, keyed by the exact text, and holds findings only (or a hash key) so text is not retained needlessly.
Before/after timings are measured by running cargo test --locked on the job's machine; if the producer cannot run it, it must say so and not invent numbers.
Earlier jobs' figures (444-466 s vs about 720 s; nextest 584 s vs 673 s) are cited as prior measurements, labelled as such, not as this job's measurements.
No fixed time target; the earlier rejections for missing one do not apply.

acceptance_criteria.text: A test in secrets.rs shows scan_text on identical text twice returns findings equal to a fresh uncached scan, and different text never returns another text's findings (including secret-bearing then clean text). Run: cargo test -p athena-gate.

A test in checks.rs shows the new poll schedule still detects a fast completion, a slow completion, and a timeout of a long-running check with the correct status. Run: cargo test -p athena-core checks.

docs/decisions.md has a new decision recording full cargo test --locked wall time before and after, labelled as measured on the job's machine with the method stated, and nextest (584 s vs 673 s, prior measurement) as a rejected alternative with the reason.
cargo test --locked passes in full, cargo clippy is clean and cargo fmt --check passes; no test is removed, ignored, weakened or filtered (git diff shows only added tests).
CHANGELOG.md has an entry for both changes. Only the four listed files change, and no governance files change.

out_of_scope: Per-binary test restructuring in athena-cli tests, common/mod.rs, or run.rs
departures: Full cargo test --locked is run twice (before and after), so cost and wall time are above the reference.
